text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and ready to take full ownership of your list building and data research needs. With 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, and data entry, I’m comfortable working with company names and website URLs to build accurate prospect lists with decision maker names, titles, emails, and LinkedIn profiles.

I have strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data visualization, which help me stay organized and efficient while handling lead generation and research tasks. I’m detail-oriented and can help ensure the data is clean, well-structured, and easy to use for outreach.

I’d love to support your software development or digital marketing lead gen efforts. What is your preferred format for the final list?
